description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Enna Kros
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Creator's Whim (0~2), removed after using Creator's Whim two times

description.name: Creator's Whim Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Creator's Whim level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Enna Kros]

description.name: Creator's Whim Level
description.text: Keeps track of Creator's Whim level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Enna Kros]
